reviewRole: Independent source reviewer, separate from Primary Implementation and Local Validation
scope: Standalone source-only mechanism for five proposed checkout identities and exact refs at repeated sequential observations

reviewFindings.finding: Exact immutable bounded proposal bytes, strict closed schema and authenticated captured AP2/AP1 helper bytes; no public injected endpoint, callback, policy or prior-result shortcut.

reviewFindings.topic: Physical checkout and all-fifteen administrative roots
reviewFindings.finding: Five separated ordinary checkouts; all15 administrative directory-root identities distinct; exact attached branch/commit, logical index/tree equality and unchanged AP2 raw scanner. Root uniqueness is not recursive storage ownership.
Runner parent list must equal exactly the proposed demo source. Dynamic pins and sibling-pin metadata are not approval; AP1 publication-delta verification remains false.
Derived HTTPS endpoint, system-path Git, null Git dir, neutral cwd, constructed environment, no fallback. Private test transport uses real bare refs; production HTTPS remains unqualified.

reviewFindings.topic: Fresh reobservation and truthful partial progress
reviewFindings.finding: Ten fresh local readers, exact planned order, completed maps after returns, attempted/completed passes, conservative network possibility flags, and overall rejection despite retained narrow completed facts.

All15 protected files individually downloaded at B/T/D and equal; all210 actual class.method identities and six raw footers per qualification transcript match exact source; independent31-method AP5 rerun passed; all19 downloaded files unchanged.

administrativeRootCheck.comparison: Pairwise uniqueness of observed device/inode pairs across all categories and roles

ap5MethodReview.description: Calls the unmodified observer local path and private file-only transport on five actual checkouts and ten real bare-ref reads; verifies heads, common/Git dirs, both pass completions, attempts, intended order, false sibling-pin metadata, helper pins/isolation flags, closed fields and unchanged fixture filesystem inventory.

Eight raw/pin cases: mismatched/uppercase/non-string/short pin, bytearray, memoryview, str and oversized bytes. Guards helper loading; requires no helper registration, no schema success and no remote attempt.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Schema/type rejection and metadata-only true case
ap5MethodReview.description: Mutates schema/type/role/scope/authority/location/ref/commit fields; removes required fields and adds endpoint/mode/report fields; requires pre-remote rejection. A proposal carrying AP1 sibling pins reports matching metadata true but fails against synthetic checkouts and never claims accepted AP1 tuple.
Rejects top-level list/null/bool, invalid UTF-8, NaN/Infinity/-Infinity, excessive nesting, and duplicate top-level/nested keys before remote work.
Rejects short names, wrong namespace, empty suffix, dot-dot, .lock/trailing-dot, wildcard, space, reflog syntax, backslash, hidden segment and overlong spelling before remote work.
Creates unstaged CRLF byte drift, missing tracked file, untracked file, ignored file and empty extra directory in hybridclr; requires rejection at that role before remotes and restores each case.
Creates staged bytes, assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, gitlink/submodule and unmerged stage-1 state in hybridclr_unity; requires pre-remote rejection, then restores.
Changes tracked-file executable mode, adds external hard link, replaces tracked regular file with symlink/FIFO/directory; requires pre-remote rejection.

Commits a literal symlink in hybridclr, pushes the new commit to its bare ref, deletes the external target, then observes success with target absent and link intact. Does not instrument every filesystem read, but source uses readlink/no-follow.
Rejects wrong or duplicate origin, filter/url rewrite/worktree/ignorestat/sparse/splitindex/diff configuration, include path, promisor/partial-clone settings and worktreeConfig extension.
Creates shallow/grafts/alternates marker files; replaces .git with a gitdir file and with a symlink; sets core.bare=true. These are direct shape tests, not a git worktree add integration.
Detaches HEAD, attaches wrong branch, converts requested branch to a symbolic alias, then advances HEAD; rejects each before remote work.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Real path/alias and proposal overlap rejection
ap5MethodReview.description: Checks symlink/noncanonical/relative/missing location values, evidence/runner overlap, workspace-history overlap, duplicate historical role, and a source-root symlink to another checkout.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Injected identity collision after real scans
ap5MethodReview.description: For four pairs (.git/.git, objects/objects, refs/refs, objects/refs), runs real checkout observation then substitutes the runner tuple with the demo tuple. Requires five stored observations but no completed local pass. Not a mounted-alias fixture.

Creates zero-parent, wrong-parent and two-parent runner commits with commit-tree, changes the runner ref/worktree and proposal pin, then requires sole-parent rejection after five local observations and before any remote call.
Accepts one exact stdout row; rejects empty, duplicate/extra blank row, wrong separator/name/SHA, uppercase, non-ASCII, extra tab, oversized data and non-bytes. Does not launch Git.

Deletes hybridclr source ref to observe failure after one completed remote; restores it and changes the demo source bare ref before the sixth query. Verifies partial attempts/maps, possible network and absent second local pass.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Injected remote failures and no fallback
ap5MethodReview.description: Injects OSError, TimeoutExpired, nonzero result, duplicate row, oversized stderr/stdout and str outputs. Requires exactly one transport call, completed first local pass, no completed remote pass and preserved first remote attempt/possible launch. These are controlled seam failures, not real waiting or huge subprocess-output tests.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Production argv/env construction plus subprocess-call assertion
ap5MethodReview.description: Supplies inherited Git/config/askpass/SSH/proxy/TLS/PATH sentinels; asserts selected system Git, no -C, null gitdir, exact endpoint/ref tail, controls and exact constructed environment. Mocks subprocess.run only to verify input/capture/cwd=/, env, timeout and check=False.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Real selected-system-Git null-gitdir behavior with network disabled
ap5MethodReview.description: Adds a benign local HTTPS-to-file rewrite, then runs production-derived argv from the checkout with file-only GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL. With null gitdir, HTTPS is rejected before network; without that option, the local rewrite resolves real bare refs. Separately confirms inherited sentinels do not change command/env. Does not run actual production HTTPS.

Wraps real checkout and location observers plus real file transport; retains ten AP1 reader objects, checks ten unique identities and the exact locations/local/remote/remote/local/locations event order.

Changes allowed config, sets index assume-unchanged, changes tracked bytes or advances local ref. Requires two completed remote passes and attempted second local pass; final locations absent. It does not assert every individual completed local-pass value in this test.

After tenth remote, renames and copies the hybridclr checkout or .git directory. Requires both local passes complete followed by checkout-state equality rejection. Tests .git replacement; separate objects/refs changes are covered by compared identity fields and collision logic, not standalone runtime fixtures here.
After tenth remote, renames and recreates originalS directory. Requires both local passes complete, both location observations recorded, and final location equality rejection.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Injected stdout-byte change over real ref output
ap5MethodReview.description: At sixth query, changes actual bare-ref stdout LF to CRLF without changing parsed SHA/ref. Requires two completed remote passes, only first local pass completed, and response-equality rejection.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Helper-byte checks and selected cleanup paths
ap5MethodReview.description: Verifies source helper pins; injects inert AP2 and AP1 byte drift, observes success and invalid-schema failure, and compares private AP2 module registry entries. AP2 mismatch rejects before registration; AP1 failure, success and schema rejection remove registration. Name says all outcomes; concrete cases are these, with other ordinary exceptions covered by source finally structure.

Preloads candidate-named module sentinels and guards builtins.__import__ for those names during real fixture observation. Verifies same module objects, sys.path identity/content, unchanged fixture inventory, empty evidence dir, no __pycache__ and closed report fields.

ap5MethodReview.kind: Public signature and immutable serialized reports
ap5MethodReview.description: Checks two-argument API signature; changes nested returned success dict without affecting stored bytes or subsequent decoded values; rejects field assignment on frozen dataclass and unsupported kwargs. Changes rejected report dict and checks fresh report retains false authority.
Launches separate CLI processes with each of -I/-S/-B missing; requires exit 2, empty stderr, structured flag reason, no remote attempt/helper registration and closed fields.

Launches CLI missing required arguments and with seven forbidden options; checks argparse exit 2/stderr/no stdout. Checks mismatched pin, invalid object/array, missing/relative input path yield pre-remote structured failures.
Launches CLI with proposal symlink, hard-linked proposal and executable proposal; requires exit 2 and no remote attempt.

additionalStaticConsiderations.assessment: Identifies observations only; does not establish accepted AP1 tuple or approval.
Equal sequential observations do not prove atomicity, frozen refs or uninterrupted custody.
All15 directory-root identities do not prove exclusive recursive storage ownership.

additionalStaticConsiderations.case: Administrative comments, representation or raw index bytes
additionalStaticConsiderations.assessment: Logical Git output comparison is not raw administrative-leaf custody.

additionalStaticConsiderations.case: Historical directory identity without authenticated contents
additionalStaticConsiderations.assessment: Protected location observation is not a historical-dataset validation or evidence promotion.

additionalStaticConsiderations.case: Completed sole-parent observation followed by later rejection
additionalStaticConsiderations.assessment: Narrow progress can remain true while all overall success/authority flags remain false.

coverageQualifications: All31 AP5 methods are direct methods of D5BFiveIdentityFocused; subtests are not extra methods.
Positive API fixtures use five real ordinary checkouts and real bare-ref output through a private file-only transport seam.
Test14 injects administrative identity collisions after real checkout scans; it is not a mounted-alias integration test.
Test18 process errors/timeouts/oversized/wrong-type output are seam injections, not measured real timeout/resource-bound experiments.
Test20 uses actual system Git with HTTPS prohibited by a file-only gate; production cwd and argv/env selection are separately asserted.
Test11 constructs gitfile/symlink representations directly, rather than creating a linked worktree with git worktree add.
Test26 enumerates selected helper cleanup outcomes; it does not empirically cover every possible exception.
True sibling-pin metadata is tested on a proposal that later rejects against fixture heads, not a positive accepted-AP1-tuple observation.
CLI tests cover argument/isolation/pretransport file failures; no positive production HTTPS CLI run was performed.
limits: Exact source-only mechanism and supplied synthetic qualification; documentation HEAD is not the CI-tested source.
Production HTTPS reachability, production five-checkout state, TLS negotiation and current physical Mac locations remain unqualified.
Fresh GitHub Connector ref reads are publication bookkeeping, not execution of AP5 production transport.
Sequential observations supply no atomicity, frozen refs, continuous/exclusive custody, change-and-return detection guarantee or future-read binding.
Logical index/configuration output equality is not raw administrative-file custody; root uniqueness is not recursive storage exclusivity.
Output bounds are checked after capture; Git capture/caches and filesystem reads have no claimed hard total process-memory/network-byte/global-wall-clock bound.
Trusted POSIX Python, system Git, standard library and OS required; no sandbox or standard-library identity attestation.
Ordinary Exception reporting only; no unconditional JSON delivery after BaseException, termination, exhaustion, serialization/output failure. Argparse has its own exit2 stderr path.
Historical host transcript/byte association does not attest its former process/worktree or current Mac state.
CI log equality covers Connector-decoded UTF8 including BOM, not original ZIP/archive bytes.
No separate fifteen-file preservation audit is asserted from CI transcript; independent exact-ref content checks establish preservation.
Only existing31-method AP5 suite independently rerun; earlier179 methods assessed by exact-source preservation and raw qualification inventories.
All Local, approval repinning, Q, native/Unity/Player, evidence promotion and later milestones remain closed.
